description: Rename a website, app, agent, or skill. A website, app, or skill moves to https://<new-name>.<org>.valet.run; the old address stops serving it and its name becomes available to another service in the same organization. An agent keeps its channels, which address it by id, and has no address to move. The architect agent cannot be renamed, and renaming an agent requires the organization to have one. A skill keeps its versions and the agents that hold it: a new version whose SKILL.md carries the new name is published, each holding agent picks the new name up on its own, and the answer names them. A skill under a well-known name, such as governance, keeps its name. Pass kind to say which you mean; a name holding another kind is then refused rather than renamed. Returns the new name, the new URL for a website, app, or skill, and for a skill the new version and the agents that hold it. Requires connecting a Valet account.

kind.description: The kind you mean. Omit to rename whatever the name holds; give it to have a name holding another kind refused.

new_name.description: The new name, lowercased before use. For a website, app, or skill it also becomes the first host label of the new URL. A skill's name never holds two hyphens in a row.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: rename_service

held_by.description: Names of the agents that hold the renamed skill; each picks up the new name on its own. Absent for other kinds and for a skill no agent holds.

kind.description: Kind renamed: site, app, agent, or skill.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

url.description: Address the service is now served at. Absent for an agent, which has no address to move, and for a skill whose route is not minted or moved yet.

version.description: Version of the release published for a renamed skill, whose SKILL.md carries the new name. Absent for other kinds.

title: Rename a website, app, agent, or skill
